// SpeakUp questions for testing GIFT import.

::speakup-gift-001::Listen and answer.{AUDIO: What did you do last weekend?}

::speakup-gift-002::[html]<p>Listen to the prompt and record your answer.</p>{
AUDIO(voice=Kore): Talk about a string instrument that you can play.
TIMELIMIT=90
LANGUAGE=en-GB
RECORDAFTERPROMPT=yes
MAXPROMPTPLAYS=2
MAXRESPONSES=1
PROMPTTRANSCRIPT=collapsed
TRANSCRIPTPENALTY=30%
GRADING=auto
TARGETITEM=(words, 50, 40%, x1)
TARGETPHRASE=("I have played", 10%, /1, partial, nocase)
COLOUR=blue
#### Thank you for your answer.
}
